verdict.rationale: DeepInfra documents a dedicated latency feature: setting service_tier to "priority" on supported models gives faster time-to-first-token and higher throughput during peak demand. It also documents dedicated autoscaling instances on A100–B300 GPUs and a fail_fast option that returns an immediate 429 instead of queuing. A community report notes cold starts of under 10s, likely avoided on popular models, which is a caveat rather than a contradiction. missing for 10: published TTFT/throughput benchmarks or latency figures, independent hands-on speed corroboration, documentation of streaming behavior, and clarity on which models support priority (it only applies 'during peak demand' on 'supported models').
